item.title: Schuylkill County Democratic Committee Announces Opposition to Proposed Tremont ICE Facility
item.description: The Schuylkill County Democratic Committee (SCDC) says it plans to formally oppose the proposed federal immigration detention facility in Tremont Township, citing financial, legal, and humanitarian concerns. item.title: Geisinger to Expand Schuylkill County Cancer Center
item.description: Geisinger is planning a $2.5 million expansion of its cancer treatment facility in Pottsville, a move health system officials say will significantly increase access to care for Schuylkill County residents while allowing more patients to receive treatment close to home. item.description: Comcast has announced the completion of a network expansion that will bring its Xfinity and Comcast Business services to thousands of additional homes and businesses throughout Schuylkill County.
